title: Keto Bhuna Potatoes
description: A spicy, crispy dish featuring light Australian new potatoes in a bhuna spice blend that's perfect for a keto-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: Spices (for bhuna spice blend)
ingredients.notes: Including cumin, coriander seeds, and chili powder, to taste.

instructions: Peel the new potatoes and slice them into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, mix the sliced potatoes with lemon juice, olive oil, spices, salt, and black pepper. Toss well to coat evenly.
Spread the coated potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper in a single layer.
Preheat your oven to 425°F (218°C). Bake for about 30 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Garnish with fresh herbs like parsley or dill if desired, serve hot as a snack.
